GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Drifted Back Settled Down 3rd/4th 3 Wide 2 Lengths Out On A Limb to Straightening Up couldn't quicken Couldn'T Go On x 200m, (b/off xovnboff) # 3 wide, folded
Jumped Ok pressed on to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, joined Straightening Up , headed approaching 200m and dropped out # led/faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race vet exam of the gelding, which weakened over the  final 200m, revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Not Bustled Settled Down Off Mid-Field Inside 4 Lengths off Inside Turning for home Ridden Along clear run home kept on okay to 100m, couldn't finish off - # found wanting late

Jumped Ok Restrained Took sit Settled Down 5th 1x1 with cover following 1st x 2 Lengths held together same to straightening up Under Pressure x 300m weakened then officially gone x 100m (w/1st) # lame 1/5
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly and shortly after was bumped. Rdr reported after enjoying a comfortable run behind the leading division, his mnt gave no response to his riding in the straight and was disappointing. A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to be lame (1/5) in the off-hind leg. Tnr was told a vet clearance will be required prior to next race/trial. Vet clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well from a low draw. Settled Down Two Wide 5th, 2.5 Lengths @ 700m. all Clear top of Straight . driven to join Lead past 200m. Kept Going Too Well from there # good trail/sound
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race vet exam after arriving late on course due to transport difficulties, and was passed suitable to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted back 4l off 3 Wide trail, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off all clear, battled on ok down the outside without threatening # did enough
Jumped Ok went to front. led turn going well. got away in Straight . pulled up with blood in nostril # too speedy
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to have blood present in its right nostril. Racing Manager was told that the gelding would be required to undergo a satisfactory gallop in the presence of a Steward under the provisions of AR79(8) before it would be permitted to race again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Rolled fwd & raced 3rd on rail (2.5L from lead) early . Back 1/2L on inside midrace & struggling to hold ground @ 500m. Chasing on inside (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & weakened in last 200m. # Struggled last 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported that near the 600m, when racing tight to the inside of another runner, his mount became awkward and got unbalanced.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Took sit 3rd Outside 1st 2 Lengths held together same to straightening up ran on with runner-up was (xovnb1st, gelded) # just too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Shifted out under pressure over the final 100 metres.
